# xmatters_services (Data Source)

Returns a list of services in your xMatters instance that match the provided criteria. Services let you define the business, technical, and external services performed by, within, or available to your enterprise – and the teams supporting them. Each service has a group assigned as its owner — a group can own multiple services, but each service can only have one owner.

## Example Usage

```terraform
// No filter is applied here returning all services
data "xmatters_services" "get_service_list" {}

// Limit the returned services by ownership
data "xmatters_services" "get_service_list_by_owner" {
  owner = "DBA_Admins"
}

// Search for services by terms and fields
data "xmatters_services" "get_service_list_with_search" {
  owner = "DBA_Admins"
  search = {
    terms   = "database postgres"
    operand = "OR"
    fields  = ["NAME"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `owner` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) or target name of the group that owns the xMatters service. Partial matches are not permitted.
- `search` (Attributes) Optional search parameters to filter the list of services returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--search))

### Read-Only

- `services` (Attributes List) List of available xMatters services. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services))

<a id="nestedatt--search"></a>
### Nested Schema for `search`

Optional:

- `fields` (List of String) Set the field to search when a search term is specified. Available options are: NAME, DESCRIPTION.
- `operand` (String) Operands expand or limit the search query parameter. OR is the default operand and returns services that have any of the search terms in the name or description. AND returns services that have all search terms in the name or description.
- `terms` (String) List of of search terms, separated by spaces. Used with the operand and fields parameters to expand or limit search results. When two or more search terms are present, the result includes services that match either search term.


<a id="nestedatt--services"></a>
### Nested Schema for `services`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the service.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the xMatters service.
- `links` (Attributes Set) List of links associated to the service and list of user-specified links for the service. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services--links))
- `name` (String) Name of the service.
- `owner` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) or target name of the group that owns the xMatters service. Partial matches are not permitted.
- `tier` (String) xMatters service tier.
- `type` (String) xMatters service type.

<a id="nestedatt--services--links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `services.links`

Read-Only:

- `link_text` (String) Link text displayed to the user.
- `url` (String) Direct URL for the link.
